deviations: Seeds: one numpy generator per cell x embedder (seed 20261114), drawn cells -> analyses (T1..T6) in the `all` run; the text-only part of T4 (n-gram overlap) uses the cell's generator of the first embedder processed (qwen3e06).

DISC-4o ORACLE-H exists only as local Qwen3 vectors (with the local ORACLE vectors of the same file): T1's ORACLE-H - ORACLE fraction uses that pair (ORACLE@local) with the Kaggle context/follow-up vectors; no BGE-M3 value.
T1 I0 pools the round-0 ideas of GEO, LLM and ORACLE (idea-level mean), not the mean of arm means.

T2(ii)/T2 classification: Holm p-values of the step-adjusted contrasts come from the cluster-robust t-test (the unadjusted families used Wilcoxon); REP-4o's adjusted E4-E6 replace E4-E6 inside the original family of 8; the TOST of an adjusted contrast uses its cluster-robust SE with G-1 df; OLMO-C uses the cluster-bootstrap CI.

T5 secondary (drop shared follow-ups): k for p is the number of follow-ups left in the f-set (k = |f-set| as in every cell script); OLMO-C's step gap keeps all follow-ups (its f-set is the consensus continuations).

T6 within-sample gradient: log(1 + n_citing_arxiv) for DISC, log(1 + n_citing_arxiv_all) for REP and OLMO-C (arXiv citing counts in both frames); the all-venue n_citing_all is reported in the frame quantiles.
Step gap of the cells without a one-shot arm (REP-4o, OLMO-C, and the 'r0' gap of every cell): median step of the context's round-0 critique ideas minus the median step of its follow-ups.
